nodes.label: nmap_main
nodes.desc: Parses options, then loops: fetch a host group, run each scan phase, emit output

nodes.label: -T0..-T5 templates
nodes.desc: T0 Paranoid means one probe at a time with 300s scan_delay; T4 caps scan delay at 10ms; T5 allows only 2 retransmissions

nodes.label: HostGroupState
nodes.desc: Holds the lookahead buffer, defer buffer and randomization used to batch targets

nodes.label: HostGroupState::get_next_host
nodes.desc: Yields the next sockaddr for the current group, skipping excluded hosts

nodes.label: HostGroupState::defer
nodes.desc: Parks problematic targets in a bounded retry buffer for later

nodes.label: getpts
nodes.desc: Parses -p port expressions into the struct scan_lists the engine consumes

nodes.label: ultra_scan
nodes.desc: Builds UltraScanInfo, starts the sniffer for raw scans, then loops pings, retransmits and fresh probes until every host is done

nodes.label: UltraScanInfo
nodes.desc: Global and per-host scan state: probe lists, timing stats, pcap handles

nodes.label: UltraProbe
nodes.desc: One scheduled probe; type is UP_IP, UP_CONNECT, UP_ARP or UP_ND

nodes.label: begin_sniffer
nodes.desc: Opens pcap capture only for raw scans; connect scans need none

nodes.label: probe main loop
nodes.desc: Each iteration runs doAnyPings, outstanding retransmits, retry-stack retransmits, then doAnyNewProbes

nodes.label: doAnyOutstandingRetransmits
nodes.desc: Resends probes that timed out, capped by max tries per probe

nodes.label: ultra_timing_vals
nodes.desc: Adaptive congestion control: ack() and drop() rescale the send rate after every response or timeout

nodes.label: scan_performance_vars
nodes.desc: Thresholds that turn RTT samples into concrete send-delay decisions

nodes.label: send_ip_packet
nodes.desc: Assembles and transmits raw IP packets, rotating decoy sources

nodes.label: send_tcp_raw
nodes.desc: Crafts the TCP segment for SYN, FIN, Xmas and NULL scans, then hands off to send_ip_packet

nodes.label: PortList::setPortState
nodes.desc: Updates open/closed/filtered for one port and remembers the old state

nodes.label: PortList::setServiceProbeResults
nodes.desc: Stores service name, version info and tunnel detected by -sV

nodes.label: service_scan
nodes.desc: Entry point: builds a ServiceGroup and drives probe scheduling through nsock

nodes.label: ServiceNFO
nodes.desc: Per-port state: pending probe list, responses so far, tunnel handling

nodes.label: ServiceGroup
nodes.desc: Three queues: services_finished, services_in_progress, services_remaining

nodes.label: startNextProbe
nodes.desc: Chooses and sends the next version probe for a service when RTT allows

nodes.label: nmap-service-probes
nodes.desc: 188 Probe definitions with regex match lines in one 17k-line database

nodes.label: OSScan::os_scan
nodes.desc: Chunks targets then dispatches IPv4 or IPv6 fingerprint runs

nodes.label: OSScan::chunk_and_do_scan
nodes.desc: Splits large host sets into chunks the OS engine can handle at once

nodes.label: HostOsScan
nodes.desc: Sends the TCP/IP probe sequence per host and classifies each response

nodes.label: open_nse
nodes.desc: Creates the Lua state with a 400MB allocation cap and a 5s per-thread interrupt timer

nodes.label: run_main
nodes.desc: C-side function registered for the Lua engine to call back into

nodes.label: main(hosts, scantype)
nodes.desc: Loaded by open_nse; sets up runlevels and starts the thread engine

nodes.label: get_chosen_scripts
nodes.desc: Resolves -sC and --script category or name specs against script.db

nodes.label: run(threads_iter)
nodes.desc: Cooperative scheduler that resumes script coroutines as sockets become ready

nodes.label: threads_iters
nodes.desc: PRE_SCAN, SCAN and POST_SCAN iterators that spawn a thread per matching prerule, hostrule or portrule

nodes.label: script_scan
nodes.desc: Invokes NSE at SCRIPT_PRE_SCAN, per-host SCRIPT_SCAN and SCRIPT_POST_SCAN
